notes:
Demand is built person-by-person from the Encuesta Origen-Destino de Viajes Santiago 2012 (SECTRA / Ministerio de Transportes), using the official 2017 census re-expansion. Each surveyed household carries a geocoded home address; each person carries a geocoded workplace or place of study plus a weekday expansion factor. One game pop = one surveyed person's home-to-work or home-to-study trip at their survey weight, scaled to the game's demand basis. No gravity model is used. 11,230 weekday households in bbox.

Residence anchoring: Censo 2017 manzana (city block) microdata from INE. Checked for suppression: comuna sums match published comuna totals exactly (e.g. Colina 146,207, Lampa 102,034), so no loss at block grain. Where the 2012 survey under-represents an area that has since grown (Chicureo, Batuco, Polpaico), synthetic households are added to match census block counts, cloned from nearby surveyed households matched on reported income. Comuna totals are preserved. This affects about 3% of the map.

Special demand (unscored): the airport, 50 university campuses and 26 hospitals are sized by the surveyed workers and tertiary students whose recorded destination falls on them, matched to OpenStreetMap amenity polygons.

Employment rate of 0.41 where census-derived employed residents are needed, derived from the survey itself (0.409).

Vintages: residence Censo 2017; workplace EOD 2012 fieldwork with 2017 re-expansion; buildings Overture/OSM 2026.

Known limitations: 2012 fieldwork re-expanded to 2017 population. Chicureo's income reference is hand-set because the 2012 survey sampled only four households there. Trip purposes are limited to work and study, which is what the game's demand model represents. — Reviewer refinements (2026-09-07; revised 2026-09-09): resident_count re-ruled total_population — the census manzana microdata counts total population; employed residents are derived by a single flat employment rate (0.41, survey-derived and disclosed by the author), so the origin anchor is a total-population count, not a measured per-block employed-resident count. workplace_granularity and od_granularity re-ruled adm3 — EOD workplaces and flows are geocoded but sample-thin (11,230 households Santiago 2012 / 7,152 Valparaiso 2014 / 1,687 San Antonio 2017); job totals and flow cells are statistically supported at comuna grain, where the census re-expansion and the author's SII validation are calibrated (comuna totals preserved). The manzana resident anchoring keeps adm5 with mesh_125_or_adm5 x measured_per_unit as filed (suppression cross-check on record). workplace_count re-ruled to the registered_self_declared rung — an expanded sample survey measures workplaces directly but is not an enumeration: the census rung requires counting where each employee works, and the full-coverage BA-register precedent (muenchen) sits at physical_inferred; sampled magnitudes with 2012-to-2017 fieldwork drift land one rung below register grade. Recorded as a value ruling per §2 rule 3 — the rung label does not literally apply, the reliability class does. od_metric re-ruled off full_matrix for the same principle — a sampled O-D matrix observes flow structure but does not count it (census-counted precedent: reunion MOBPRO). Scored structured_marginals at adm3: complete sampled pairwise structure across the survey area (roughly 220 surveyed households per comuna).
